original.prompt: In May 2026, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh signed three defence Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with South Korea in Seoul. Consider the following statements:
items: One of the MoUs covers defence cyber cooperation.
One of the MoUs provides for training exchanges between India's National Defence College and Korea National Defence University.
Rajnath Singh's two-nation tour, which ended in Seoul, began in Japan.
original.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: The tour began in Vietnam, not Japan. The three MoUs covered defence cyber cooperation, training exchanges between the two national defence colleges, and peacekeeping operations.
original.source: The Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) cover defence cyber cooperation, training exchanges between India's National Defence College and Korea National Defence University, and peacekeeping operations.

rewritten.prompt: In May 2026, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh signed three defence Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with South Korea in Seoul. Consider the following statements:
items: One of the MoUs provides for training exchanges between India's National Defence Academy and Korea National Defence University.
L&T and Hanwha signed three commercial agreements on defence technology at a business roundtable chaired by Singh in Seoul.
Rajnath Singh's two-nation tour, which ended in Seoul, began in Japan.
rewritten.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
rewritten.explain: All three statements are wrong: the training MoU links India's National Defence College (not the National Defence Academy) with Korea National Defence University, L&T and Hanwha signed two (not three) commercial agreements, and the tour began in Vietnam, not Japan. Both sides also discussed operationalising KIND-X, a joint platform for co-developing and co-producing defence systems.
rewritten.source: L&T and Hanwha also signed two commercial agreements on defence technology at a business roundtable Singh chaired in Seoul.
